title.narrative: Advancing Risk-Informed Resilience for Communities in South-East Europe

description.narrative: This initiative will support communities across South-East Europe to better understand and manage disaster risks through science-based approaches, knowledge sharing, and capacity development. The project will promote collaboration among scientists, local authorities, practitioners, and community organizations to strengthen preparedness and resilience to natural hazards and climate-related risks. Activities will include a regional consultation meeting, tailored training programmes, peer-learning exchanges, and the development of practical knowledge products. Deliverables will include a regional cooperation roadmap, guidance materials, and a collection of good practices to support risk-informed planning, community resilience, and sustainable development across the region.
